theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm n n, Nat.mul_add_right]
  have : (n * (n + 1)) % 2 = 0 :=
    by
      cases' n with k
      · exact_mod_two 0 0
      · have h : (k + 1) % 2 = 1 := by rw [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.mod_two_eq_one_iff_odd]
        rw [Nat.mul_mod_two, Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_iff_even]
        exact_mod_two k (k + 1)
  exact this
